blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines— Adamson coach Nash Racela questioned the handling of the game’s final play after the Soaring Falcons fell to University of the Philippines, 69-67, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday. Racela said a foul–or at least, a review–should have been called when Adamson guard Matthew Montebon heaved up a last-second 3-point Hail Mary at the buzzer. Replays showed UP’s Dikachi Udodo reaching in as Montebon attempted the shot. Racela and the Adamson coaching staff also said they heard a whistle. “We heard the whistle from the referee, […]...
